description: Defines data classes and logic for managing and displaying the state of app installation notifications in an Android application, including progress, categories, and UI text generation.

classes.name: InstallNotificationState
classes.description: Represents the current state of installation notifications, including progress, app categories, and UI text generation.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Represents the state of an individual app within the installation process.

classes.name: AppStateCategory
classes.description: Enumeration of possible app states: INSTALLING, NEEDS_CONFIRMATION, and INSTALLED.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Generates the notification title based on current app states and progress.

methods.name: getBigText
methods.description: Creates a detailed notification text listing apps by their current installation category.

methods.name: getSuccessTitle
methods.description: Returns a success notification title indicating number of installed apps.

methods.name: getSuccessBigText
methods.description: Returns a detailed list of installed apps for success notification.
